notes.title: 1.0.1 Minor Update
notes.content:
First and foremost,
Thank you to everyone who supported Spaghet!

[b]Now, about the update:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Corrected the leaderboard. The leaderboard was originally showing shorter times as the better scores. It should be the opposite. The longer you last in the game, the better you rank on the leaderboard.
    [*]Fixed a minor graphical bug with the standing lamps around the room that caused them to partially glow orange when the lights go out.
[/list]

tags.bug: Corrected the leaderboard. The leaderboard was originally showing shorter times as the better scores. It should be the opposite. The longer you last in the game, the better you rank on the leaderboard.
Fixed a minor graphical bug with the standing lamps around the room that caused them to partially glow orange when the lights go out.
